memory_candidates.content: Lean 4 identifiers accept subscript digits and the subscript letters ₐ–ₜ (e.g. ₙ, ₚ) but NOT the subscript minus ₋ (U+208B) or subscript plus ₊ (U+208A); a plan that names declarations T₋/ℓ₋/N₊ needs Tₙ/ℓₙ/Npos (or similar) at implementation time. Surfaces as a bare 'expected token' parse error at the identifier.

To read closure letters off a clSig alphabet, do not `rcases ℓ with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ | ⟨⟩` directly: it unfolds (clSig φ).preds to the raw Sum and leaves a goal that is not type-correct at reducible transparency, so neither `simp` nor `rw [clTrace_letter]` fires. Use an exhaustion lemma `letter_cases : ℓ = clNow φ ∨ ∃ ψ hψ, ℓ = clLetter φ hψ` with hψ typed at plusSubformulaClosure, then `rcases letter_cases ℓ with rfl | ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩`.

When slicing a markdown plan section in a script, anchor the end marker as a full heading line ('\n## Heading\n'), never a bare substring: '## Lean Challenge Statements' also occurs inline in the Goals paragraph, and a bare index silently duplicated ~580 lines of plan text in a committed edit.
